in_arabic.name: Farniya
in_arabic.meaning: اسم عربي يعني Gardener of the Garden
in_arabic.long_meaning: Farniya هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. In Islamic tradition, Farniya is the one who tends to the Garden of Paradise. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'Farra' which means 'garden' and 'Niya' meaning 'she' or 'her'.
